reviews.author: Riddhi Borkar
reviews.body: Lip Scrub ko suitable routine mein use karke lips ko smoother-looking appearance ke liye prepare kiya ja sakta hai, while balm can be part of the nourishing care step. Lip Bright overall combo ko additional focused-care element deta hai.

reviews.author: Yuvansh Kohli
reviews.body: Lip Bright, Lip Scrub aur Lip Balm ko combine karna beauty routine ke liye ek well-rounded concept create karta hai.

sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
Step 1: Exfoliate (Lip Scrub)Start with clean, dry lips. Take a small amount of lip scrub and gently massage in circular motions for 30–60 seconds. This helps remove dead skin, dryness, and flakiness. Wipe off or rinse gently.

Step 2: Treat (Lip Bright Peel-Off Mask)Apply an even layer of the Lip Bright Mask on your lips. Let it dry completely (approx. 10–15 minutes), then gently peel it off from the edges. This step helps in deep cleansing, smoothening, and improving the overall appearance of lips.

Step 3: Nourish & Protect (Lip Balm)Finish with your favourite Lip Balm. Apply evenly to lock in moisture, keep lips soft, hydrated, and protected throughout the day. Reapply as needed.
